scripts.dev:web: corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @foreman-code/contracts --filter @foreman-code/web dev
scripts.dev:api: corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @foreman-code/contracts --filter @foreman-code/api dev
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ci-remote.mjs typecheck -- node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck"
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-worker-imports.mjs && node scripts/ci-remote.mjs lint -- node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --no-bail --no-sort --if-present lint"
scripts.test: node scripts/ci-remote.mjs unit -- node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- node scripts/test-command.mjs -- sh -c "corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && corepack pnpm -r --no-bail --workspace-concurrency=1 --if-present test && corepack pnpm test:scripts"
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/ci-remote.mjs integration -- node scripts/heavy-job.mjs --timeout-ms 9000000 -- node scripts/test-integration.mjs
scripts.test:acceptance: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- node scripts/test-command.mjs -- sh -c 'corepack pnpm --filter @foreman-code/contracts build && node scripts/test-native-acceptance.mjs "$@"' --
scripts.test:production: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs -- node scripts/test-command.mjs -- node scripts/production-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:files: node scripts/heavy-job.mjs --timeout-ms 9000000 -- node scripts/test-command.mjs -- node scripts/test-files.mjs
